bias.en: Rebound fading · $338 low, MACD near a cross
bias.zh: 反弹减弱 · 盘中低见 $338，MACD 接近交叉

read.en: Applied Materials fell 0.3% on Nov 17 to $349.23, trading $338.00–355.70. It is below the 5-day ($369.2, still rising), 10-day ($361.1), 30-day ($404.8), 100-day ($482.0) and 200-day ($446.8). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram fading toward a cross; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($323.76), and RSI is 38.6.
read.zh: 应用材料 11月17日下跌 0.3%，收于 $349.23，盘中区间 $338.00–355.70。股价位于 5 日（$369.2，仍在上行）、10 日（$361.1）、30 日（$404.8）、100 日（$482.0）和 200 日均线（$446.8）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄、趋向交叉；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$323.76），RSI 为 38.6。

read.en: The $338.00 low dipped under the $343–346 support (Nov 9 and 16 lows), but the close held above it. Resistance is $355.7–361.1 (Nov 17 high, 10-day), then $369.2–372.5 (5-day, Nov 13 and 10 closes) and $381. Support is $338–343, then $332.7 (Nov 6 close) and $317–324 (Nov 5 low, SAR). A close above $361.1 would target $369–372.5; below $338, $332.7.
